purpose: keep servers, networks and platform components patched, supported and healthy through planned changes
entry_criteria: Inventory of infrastructure and versions exists
Maintenance windows and owners are defined
Rollback or replacement approach is known
procedure: Review the inventory for items with security patches due, nearing end of support or showing health problems.
Plan the change: scope, order, window, communication and rollback; roll out to non-production first.
Apply changes in small batches using automation, with health checks between batches.
Verify service health and capacity afterward and compare with the baseline.
Update the inventory and retire items that are out of support.
Record the work, exceptions and the next planned maintenance.
acceptance_criteria: Security patches are applied within the agreed time or excepted
Rollout was staged with health checks
Exceptions have an owner and an expiry
validation_method: Platform owner review of the results.

validation.command: kubectl get nodes -o wide   # example; use the platform's inventory command
validation.expect: all nodes at the target version and Ready

validation.check: list inventory items past end of support
validation.expect: none without an exception or retirement plan

failure_modes.response: Stop, roll back the batch, and fix before continuing

failure_modes.detection: Items past end of support without plan
failure_modes.response: Schedule retirement or accept risk with expiry

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Nodes are upgraded in batches of two with a health check between batches; one node fails its check and is replaced, and the inventory is updated to the new versions.
